description: This file defines the interface for memory attribute management in Zephyr OS, including structures, macros, and function prototypes related to memory regions and attributes.

methods.name: mem_attr_get_regions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of memory regions with their attributes gathered from device tree.

methods.name: mem_attr_check_buf
methods.description: Checks if a buffer's size and attributes match a memory region.
